views.name: orders_enriched_with_customer
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  o.order_id,
  o.customer_id,
  c.customer_unique_id,
  c.customer_zip_code_prefix,
  c.customer_city,
  c.customer_state,
  o.order_status,
  o.order_purchase_timestamp,
  o.order_approved_at,
  o.order_delivered_carrier_date,
  o.order_delivered_customer_date,
  o.order_estimated_delivery_date
FROM olist_orders o
LEFT JOIN olist_customers c
  ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
views.description: One row per order with customer attributes joined. Useful as a base for order-level analyses that need customer geography or unique customer identifiers (customer_unique_id). | Use for: order lifecycle timing (purchase -> delivered) by customer geography; customer-level ordering patterns using customer_unique_id; order status distributions by state or city

views.name: order_items_with_product_and_seller
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  oi.order_id,
  oi.order_item_id,
  oi.product_id,
  p.product_category_name,
  p.product_name_lenght,
  p.product_description_lenght,
  p.product_photos_qty,
  p.product_weight_g,
  p.product_length_cm,
  p.product_height_cm,
  p.product_width_cm,
  oi.seller_id,
  s.seller_zip_code_prefix,
  s.seller_city,
  s.seller_state,
  oi.shipping_limit_date,
  oi.price,
  oi.freight_value
FROM olist_order_items oi
LEFT JOIN olist_products p
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN olist_sellers s
  ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
views.description: One row per order item (order_id + order_item_id) with product attributes and seller location attached. Useful for item-level revenue analyses, product category performance, and seller geographies. | Use for: item-level revenue and freight analysis by product category; seller performance and geography for sold items; product dimension correlations with price or freight

views.name: order_payments_aggregated
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  order_id,
  COUNT(*) AS payment_attempts,
  SUM(payment_value) AS payment_value_total,
  AVG(payment_value) AS payment_value_avg,
  SUM(payment_installments) AS payment_installments_total
FROM olist_order_payments
GROUP BY order_id
views.description: Aggregated payment-level metrics per order. Produces one row per order with total payment_value, total_installments (sum of installments across payments), number_of_payment_attempts, and average payment_value. Useful to reconcile order totals and analyze payment behavior. | Use for: order-level revenue validation vs sum of item prices; payment method usage patterns and installments analysis; detecting multi-payment orders or partial payments

views.name: products_category_profile
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  product_category_name,
  COUNT(product_id) AS product_count,
  AVG(product_weight_g) AS product_weight_g_avg,
  AVG(product_name_lenght) AS product_name_lenght_avg,
  AVG(product_description_lenght) AS product_description_lenght_avg,
  AVG(product_photos_qty) AS product_photos_qty_avg,
  AVG(product_length_cm) AS product_length_cm_avg,
  AVG(product_height_cm) AS product_height_cm_avg,
  AVG(product_width_cm) AS product_width_cm_avg
FROM olist_products
GROUP BY product_category_name
views.description: One row per product_category_name with descriptive aggregates: product_count, avg_weight_g, avg_price_placeholder and median-like proxies for product name/description length. Note: price is not available in products table; downstream joins to order_items can supply price if needed. Use for category-level profiling. | Use for: category profiling and feature engineering for modeling; compare physical dimensions across categories; identify categories with many or few products

views.name: reviews_per_order
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  order_id,
  COUNT(review_id) AS review_count,
  AVG(review_score) AS review_score_avg,
  MIN(review_creation_date) AS review_first_created_at,
  MAX(review_creation_date) AS review_last_created_at
FROM olist_order_reviews
GROUP BY order_id
views.description: One row per order with aggregated review metrics: number of reviews and average review score and earliest/latest review timestamps. Useful to link review sentiment to order outcomes or delivery timing. | Use for: associate reviews with order delivery times; identify orders with multiple reviews or delayed feedback; compute average satisfaction per order

views.name: geolocation_zip_median_point
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
  AVG(geolocation_lat) AS geolocation_lat,
  AVG(geolocation_lng) AS geolocation_lng,
  MIN(geolocation_city) AS geolocation_city,
  MIN(geolocation_state) AS geolocation_state,
  COUNT(*) AS samples_count
FROM olist_geolocation
GROUP BY geolocation_zip_code_prefix
views.description: One representative lat/lng per geolocation_zip_code_prefix using the average (centroid). Normalizes the many-to-many geolocation samples into a single coordinate per zip prefix to simplify geospatial joins at zip prefix granularity. | Use for: map customers or sellers to a single coordinate for plotting; calculate distances between zip prefixes using centroid coords; reduce multiplicity when joining geolocation to customers/sellers

views.name: orders_with_items_payments_reviews_customers
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  o.order_id,
  o.customer_id,
  c.customer_unique_id,
  c.customer_zip_code_prefix,
  c.customer_city,
  c.customer_state,
  o.order_status,
  o.order_purchase_timestamp,
  o.order_approved_at,
  o.order_delivered_carrier_date,
  o.order_delivered_customer_date,
  o.order_estimated_delivery_date,
  COALESCE(oi_tot.items_count,0) AS items_count,
  COALESCE(oi_tot.items_price_total,0.0) AS items_price_total,
  COALESCE(oi_tot.items_freight_total,0.0) AS items_freight_total,
  COALESCE(pay.payment_attempts,0) AS payment_attempts,
  COALESCE(pay.payment_value_total,0.0) AS payment_value_total,
  COALESCE(rev.review_count,0) AS review_count,
  rev.review_score_avg
FROM olist_orders o
LEFT JOIN olist_customers c
  ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    COUNT(*) AS items_count,
    SUM(price) AS items_price_total,
    SUM(freight_value) AS items_freight_total
  FROM olist_order_items
  GROUP BY order_id
) oi_tot
  ON o.order_id = oi_tot.order_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    COUNT(*) AS payment_attempts,
    SUM(payment_value) AS payment_value_total
  FROM olist_order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id
) pay
  ON o.order_id = pay.order_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    COUNT(review_id) AS review_count,
    AVG(review_score) AS review_score_avg
  FROM olist_order_reviews
  GROUP BY order_id
) rev
  ON o.order_id = rev.order_id
views.description: Denormalized order-level relation that joins orders to aggregated items (sum price/freight), aggregated payments, aggregated reviews, and customer attributes. Produces one row per order and is useful for end-to-end order analyses without needing many downstream joins. | Use for: end-to-end order health: paid amount vs items total vs reviews vs delivery time; identify orders with mismatched payment totals; aggregate cohort metrics by customer geography or status

views.name: product_category_translation_join
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.product_id,
  p.product_category_name,
  t.product_category_name_english,
  p.product_name_lenght,
  p.product_description_lenght,
  p.product_photos_qty,
  p.product_weight_g,
  p.product_length_cm,
  p.product_height_cm,
  p.product_width_cm
FROM olist_products p
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t
  ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
views.description: One row per product with English translation of product_category_name. Useful to present human-readable category names or to group by English category labels in reports. | Use for: translate category labels for dashboards or exports; group sales by English category labels; merge product metadata with translated category for labeling

views.name: seller_location_profile
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  seller_id,
  seller_zip_code_prefix,
  seller_city,
  seller_state
FROM olist_sellers
views.description: One row per seller_id carrying seller location attributes and zip prefix to enable stable joins. Use when seller geography is needed without modifying original seller master data. | Use for: map seller_id to state/city for aggregation; join sellers to geolocation by zip prefix

views.name: customers_unique_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  customer_unique_id,
  customer_zip_code_prefix,
  customer_city,
  customer_state
FROM olist_customers
views.description: A customer-level projection suitable as a cohort base: one row per customer with customer_unique_id and location. Use to filter or cohort by geography or unique customer grouping. | Use for: build customer cohorts by state or city; link customers to orders and aggregate unique buyers
